text: The repository is split into backend (the pipeline engine and agents), frontend (the editor UI), and llm_config (provider routing for OpenAI and Ollama).
To set up a local dev environment, create a virtual environment, then install requirements.txt with pip. Python 3.11 or later is required.
Run the backend test suite with pytest from the repository root; pytest.ini sets pythonpath so bare imports like 'import agents' resolve correctly.
Every pull request needs at least one review and a passing test run before merging; keep PRs focused on a single change so review stays fast.
The CI pipeline runs linting, the pytest suite, and a build step on every push; a failing stage blocks merge until it's fixed.
On-call engineers respond to paging alerts within fifteen minutes and follow the incident runbook to triage, mitigate, and then write a postmortem.
Use snake_case for functions and variables, PascalCase for classes, and keep docstrings to one line unless a non-obvious constraint needs explaining.
Architecture decision records live under docs/ and capture the reasoning behind major structural choices, such as splitting agents.py from base_classes.py.
